summary: Bulk-reloads .veh vehicle files from the season directory into the global vehicle array. Resets the directory-search state, enumerates files filtered by the .veh extension, tears down any previously allocated vehicle array (1060-byte entries, count stored in a 4-byte header), allocates a fresh array sized by the entry count, then iterates directory entries building full paths, parsing each .veh into its slot, and incrementing the loaded-vehicle count on success. On parse failure it runs a version/format marker check and logs a 'Failed reading %s' error. Ends by delegating loaded data to VehicleDataLoader and returning the final vehicle count.

operations.description: Reset the directory-search state object at dword_8AD3B0 before starting the scan.
Select the season-name path component: use dword_5EC428, falling back to byte_5EA438 when null.
Select the season-directory path component: use dword_5EC3D8, falling back to byte_5EA438 when null.
Build the season directory path into SrcStr with the '%s%s' format (directory + name) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Start enumeration of the season directory filtered by the '.veh' extension (sub_565F80 with aVeh and the built path).
If a previously allocated vehicle array (dword_8AC394) exists, tear it down before reloading.
Walk the existing array backwards in 1060-byte steps calling MultiFieldCleanup on each entry; the entry count is read from the 4-byte header at dword_8AC394 - 4.
Free the old array allocation including its count-header block (pointer at dword_8AC394 - 4).
Count the directory entries from the search state via ShortComputation_5f70 on dword_8AD3B0.
Allocate (1060 * count + 4) bytes for the new vehicle array plus its count header via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
Store the entry count in the 4-byte header and set dword_8AC394 to the array payload (allocation + 4); on allocation failure set dword_8AC394 to 0.
Initialize each new 1060-byte entry (265 dwords) via sub_4C3050.
Pop the first node from the search list via LinkedListPopFront_5f50.
Iterate the remaining directory entries via DirectoryEntryIterator on the search state.
Re-resolve the season-name and season-directory path components per entry using the same null fallbacks to byte_5EA438.
Build the full file path with the '%s%s%s' format (directory + name + entry) into SrcStr.
Load the file at the constructed path via sub_589901.
Grow/reallocate the scratch buffer holding the file data via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Parse the .veh content into the current array slot (dword_8AC394 + 1060 * dword_8AC390) via VehFileParser.
On parse failure (VehFileParser returns non-null) run the version/format check; on success increment the loaded-vehicle count dword_8AC390.
On parse failure, run StringSplitLoop(1, version/format marker string aDDevF119992002_8, 516) to check the file's format marker.
When the format check passes, log the 'Failed reading %s' error via DebugLogWrite into the debug buffer dword_8AD25C.
If LinkedListNodePeek reports no next node in the search list, break out of the entry loop.
Reset the directory-search state again after enumeration completes.
Load vehicle data from the parsed entries by delegating to VehicleDataLoader(this).
Return the total loaded vehicle count dword_8AC390.
